top_signals.title: Iran War Is Pushing Record Numbers of Fuel Tankers Into Crude Trade
top_signals.summary: The Middle East crisis and upended crude and fuel flows have accelerated a shift in the global tanker fleet that began last year. A growing number of the so-called long-range-2 (LR2) clean tankers that have transported fuels such as diesel and gasoline have become the so-called dirty tankers and started shipping crude. As of this week, a record-high share of 75% of the global LR2 fleet is engaged in dirty crude transportation, while the number and share of tankers moving petroleum products, the so-called clean vessels, have dropped to record lows,…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Soy Oil Hits Nine-Month Low as Strong Meal Demand Boosts Crush
top_signals.summary: Soybean oil prices fell to their lowest level since February as high demand for meal boosted crushing, while weakening crude added pressure ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday in the US.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
